// Generator of go-oracle-neturl.json: what url.Parse, strconv.Atoi and
// strconv.ParseFloat of the freeze commit's toolchain (go 1.27, so the strict
// colon rule of url is on, as for go.mod's go 1.27.1) return on hostile input.
// Kept as text; regenerate with:
// mkdir /tmp/x && cp go-oracle-neturl.go.txt /tmp/x/main.go && (cd /tmp/x && go run main.go) > go-oracle-neturl.json
package main

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"math"
	"net/url"
	"os"
	"strconv"
)

type urlCase struct {
	In          string `json:"in"`
	Err         bool   `json:"err"`
	Scheme      string `json:"scheme"`
	Opaque      string `json:"opaque"`
	User        string `json:"user"`
	HasUser     bool   `json:"hasUser"`
	Host        string `json:"host"`
	Path        string `json:"path"`
	RawPath     string `json:"rawPath"`
	RawQuery    string `json:"rawQuery"`
	Fragment    string `json:"fragment"`
	RawFragment string `json:"rawFragment"`
	Hostname    string `json:"hostname"`
	String      string `json:"string"`
	// Clean is url.URL{Scheme, Host, Path, Fragment}.String(), as
	// security.integrity rebuilds a URL.
	Clean string `json:"clean"`
}

type atoiCase struct {
	In  string `json:"in"`
	Err bool   `json:"err"`
	Out string `json:"out"`
}

type floatCase struct {
	In  string `json:"in"`
	Err bool   `json:"err"`
	// Out is the value as strconv.FormatFloat(x, 'g', -1, 64), or NaN/+Inf/-Inf.
	Out string `json:"out"`
}

var urls = []string{
	"https://registry.npmjs.org/a/-/a-1.0.0.tgz", "http://x", "HTTPS://Reg.Example.COM:8443/p?q#f",
	"git+ssh://git@github.com/x/y.git#abc", "git@gitlab.example:x/scp.git", "github:acme/shorthand#0123",
	"file:vendor/c-1.0.0.tgz", "file:s3cret@vendor/d.tgz", "file:///abs/path.tgz", "file://host/p", "file:",
	"https:s3cret@downloads.example.org/a.tgz", "git+ssh:s3cret@github.com:acme/b.git",
	"https://user:pa ss@h/", "https://user:p%41ss@h/", "https://u@h@i/", "https://u:p@ss@h/", "https://us{er@h/",
	"https://h/a%20b", "https://h/a%zz", "https://h/a b", "https://h/%", "https://h/%4", "https://h/a%2fb", "https://h/%2F",
	"https://[::1]:8080/x", "https://[fe80::1%25en0]/x", "https://[::1/x", "https://[1.2.3.4]/x", "https://[::ffff:1.2.3.4]/x",
	"https://[::]/", "https://[1:2:3:4:5:6:7:8]/", "https://[1:2:3:4:5:6:7:8:9]/", "https://[1::2::3]/", "https://[12345::]/",
	"https://[::1]x/", "https://a[::1]/", "https://[fe80::1%25]/", "https://[fe80::1%25%41]/", "https://[1:2:3:4:5:6:1.2.3.4]/",
	"https://[::01.2.3.4]/", "https://[g::]/", "https://[::1]:/",
	"https://h:abc/x", "https://h:/x", "https://h:8080", "https://:8080/", "https://h:1:2/", "ssh://h:1:2/", "git+ssh://a:b:22/x",
	"https://h%41/x", "https://h%c3%a9/x", "https://hé/x", "https://h x/", "https://h\"/", "https://h</", "https://h{/", "https://h|/",
	"https://h%25/", "https://h_x/", "https://H.EXAMPLE/",
	"//h/p", "///p", "/p", "p:q", "a/b:c", "1http://x", "+x:y", ":x", "", "*", "a:", "a:/", "a://", "A1+-.:x",
	"https://h/p?", "https://h/p??", "https://h/p?a?", "https://h/p#a#b", "https://h/p#%zz", "https://h/p#%41", "https://h/p#a b",
	"https://h/p#", "#frag", "?q", "https://h/p#<>", "https://h/p#!$&'()*+,;=",
	"http://h\x01/", "http://h\x7f", "http://h/\x00", "http://h/p\tq",
	"mailto:x@y", "https://h/p;x", "https://h/p?x=1#0123456789abcdef", "HTTP://H/", "git://h/p", "bitbucket:a/b", "ssh://h/p",
	"https://h/../a", "https://h/日本", "https://h/p#日本", "https://Ü.example/", "https://@h/", "https://u:@h/", "https://h/p\\q",
	"https://h//double", "https:////x", "a:////x", "x//y", "./a:b", "\xff://h", "https://h/\xff", "https://\xff/",
	"https://user:%zz@h/", "https://%41@h/", "https://u%3Ap@h/",
}

var ints = []string{
	"0", "1", "-1", "+1", "01", "", "+", "-", " 1", "1 ", "1_0", "0x10", "9223372036854775807", "9223372036854775808",
	"-9223372036854775808", "-9223372036854775809", "99999999999999999999", "١", "1.0", "1e3", "00000000000000000000000001",
}

var floats = []string{
	"9.8", "7.5", "5.0", "3.1", "0", "-1", "", "x", " 9 ", "9.", ".5", "5.", "+5", "-0", "9e0", "9E0", "9e", "9e+", "9e-1",
	"0x1p3", "0x10", "0x1.8p1", "0X1P-2", "0x_1p3", "0x1_0p0", "0x.p1", "0xp1", "0x1p", "inf", "Inf", "+Inf", "-inf", "INFINITY",
	"infinity", "+infinity", "-Infinity", "infin", "NaN", "nan", "+nan", "-NaN", "1_0", "1__0", "_1", "1_", "1_.5", "1._5",
	"1e1_0", "0b1", "0o7", "1,5", "١", "1e400", "-1e400", "1e-400", "1e308", "1.7976931348623157e308", "1.7976931348623159e308",
	"4.9e-324", "2e-324", "3.9999999999999999", "8.99999999999999999999", "6.9999999999999999999999", "0x1p1024", "0x1p-1080",
	"00.5", "0.05", "1e99999", "0e99999", "..5", "5..", "1.2.3", "1e2e3", "0x1.fffffffffffff8p1023", "123456789012345678901234567890",
}

func formatFloat(f float64) string {
	switch {
	case math.IsNaN(f):
		return "NaN"
	case math.IsInf(f, 1):
		return "+Inf"
	case math.IsInf(f, -1):
		return "-Inf"
	}
	return strconv.FormatFloat(f, 'g', -1, 64)
}

// bs writes a Go string as a byte string: one character (U+0000 to U+00FF)
// per byte, so that bytes that are no UTF-8 survive the JSON file.
func bs(s string) string {
	r := make([]rune, len(s))
	for i := 0; i < len(s); i++ {
		r[i] = rune(s[i])
	}
	return string(r)
}

func main() {
	var us []urlCase
	for _, in := range urls {
		c := urlCase{In: bs(in)}
		u, err := url.Parse(in)
		if err != nil {
			c.Err = true
		} else {
			c.Scheme, c.Opaque, c.Host, c.Path, c.RawPath = bs(u.Scheme), bs(u.Opaque), bs(u.Host), bs(u.Path), bs(u.RawPath)
			c.RawQuery, c.Fragment, c.RawFragment = bs(u.RawQuery), bs(u.Fragment), bs(u.RawFragment)
			c.HasUser = u.User != nil
			c.User = bs(u.User.String())
			c.Hostname = bs(u.Hostname())
			c.String = bs(u.String())
			clean := url.URL{Scheme: u.Scheme, Host: u.Host, Path: u.Path, Fragment: u.Fragment}
			c.Clean = bs(clean.String())
		}
		us = append(us, c)
	}
	var is []atoiCase
	for _, in := range ints {
		n, err := strconv.Atoi(in)
		is = append(is, atoiCase{In: in, Err: err != nil, Out: strconv.Itoa(n)})
	}
	var fs []floatCase
	for _, in := range floats {
		f, err := strconv.ParseFloat(in, 64)
		fs = append(fs, floatCase{In: in, Err: err != nil, Out: formatFloat(f)})
	}
	out := map[string]any{
		"recordedFrom": "238e07f66d8cafab24ef363cb79e207bd48babd8 (go1.27.3)",
		"url":          us,
		"atoi":         is,
		"parseFloat":   fs,
	}
	enc := json.NewEncoder(os.Stdout)
	enc.SetIndent("", "  ")
	if err := enc.Encode(out); err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
}
